name: Arona (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, green and blue.
history: The flag of Arona was approved by the Government of the Canary Islands by order of 17 July 1998, as a rectangular cloth of silk, taffeta, satin, wool or synthetic fibre whose length is one and a half times its width, composed of three horizontal stripes of equal size; if the flag bears the arms they are placed at the centre, preferably on both sides.
